title: Little Roots Family Music Time
description: A 45-minute music session for children ages 0-5 with a caregiver to develop a love of music through song and movement. No registration is required for this free program.

title: Pokémon Club
description: Learn how to play the Pokémon card game, or just have fun crafting and hanging out with other Pokémon fans! Come to any or all of the club meetings! For ages 5 to 18. Ages 8 and under must be with caregiver.

title: Main Street Redesign and Pedestrian Improvements Public Meeting
description: Public meeting with MaineDOT and the City of Westbrook to learn about and comment on the Main Street redesign (pavement overlay, wider sidewalks, esplanades, raised crosswalks, improved crossing signals, ADA upgrades). Covers Route 25/Main St to Captain Bill Hartley Ave, excluding Bridge St to Westbrook Common. Comments can also be submitted online 11/9-11/25. Second meeting planned for fall 2027.

title: Friends of the Presumpscot River Drop-In
description: Drop in anytime for refreshments, river updates and community connection. Free pizza; beverages for purchase.

title: Annual Meeting & Celebration
description: Pop in anytime. Free pizza and nibbles, 2026 highlights, how your support made an impact, and a look at plans for 2027. Beverages for purchase.

title: Stuff-A-Bus Food Drive (Weekend 2)
description: Food drive to benefit Westbrook School Department students and families, from Westbrook School Nutrition. Non-perishables needed: snacks, canned vegetables/soup/beans (flip top), canned protein, grains, oils, potatoes, pasta/rice, cereal, peanut butter and jelly, shelf-stable milk, fruit cups, tea/coffee, sugar and flour. First weekend Nov 7-8.

title: Craft & Vendor Fair
description: Free entry. Sponsored by WMS PTO. Contact westbrookmiddleschoolpto@gmail.com for more information.

title: Historical Walk at Gambo Preserve (and Orchard Ridge Farm!)
description: PRLT and Don Wescott lead a roughly two-hour trail loop walk on the history of the Gambo Powder Mill, plus stewardship, trail maintenance and interpretive signage. Afterward, optional brief hike on the Mountain Division Trail to Orchard Ridge Farm for a local fall treat. Free, but registration required: https://secure.lglforms.com/form_engine/s/RX0zfCyhxyB1X8OWqXDrwg. Rain date: Sunday, November 15.

title: **Cancelled**- Waterfront Concerts presents: “An Evening with The Rush Tribute Project”
description: Due to a scheduling conflict, The Rush Tribute Project show on November 14th has been canceled. Tickets will be refunded automatically at the point of purchase.

title: Special City Council Meeting
description: Westbrook City Council meets in person at Westbrook High School (125 Stroudwater Street) in Room 114. A remote participation option is available. Written public comments must be received by the City Clerk's Office no later than 10am the morning of the meeting.

title: Family Storytime at Walker Library
venue: Walker Memorial Library, Youth Services Program Room
description: Family Storytime at Walker Memorial Library is geared to ages 1-3 with caregivers, but all ages are welcome. We will sing, move around, read books, and have fun! Storytimes are Tuesdays and Thursdays at 10:30am in the Youth Services Program Room.

title: Baby Lapsit - Under age 2
description: Baby Lapsit is a gentle storytime for babies under age 2 and their caregivers. A gentle program of rhyming, reading, and playtime. On Wednesdays from 10:30am-11 in our Youth Program Room.

title: Silly Science - Mushrooms
description: Silly science: Mushrooms! Learn a bit of mushroom science and have a lot of fun with us! Make a few mushrooms out of egg cartons and corks! Geared to ages 5 - 10 but open to everyone.

title: Hanging out in the Historic Wing
description: Hang out with us upstairs in our historic wing! Knit/crochet/stitch, read a book, make a puzzle, play a game, or just sit and enjoy the atmosphere!

title: New York Voices and Portland Jazz Orchestra
venue: Westbrook Performing Arts Center, 471 Stroudwater St, Westbrook, ME 04092
description: Jazz concert featuring vocal group New York Voices with the Portland Jazz Orchestra. Ticket price not confirmed.

title: Silent Book Club
description: Enjoy quiet reading in our beautiful historic wing with other patrons. Be part of our silent book club with no commitments, no assigned reading, and no required discussion! Audiobooks are welcome, but headphones are required; all ages that can read silently are welcome, but under age 8 must be with an adult.

title: Mobile Food Pantry Thanksgiving Food Event
description: Westbrook Families Feeding Families. Stops: The Point (Bracket St) 10-11 AM; Saint Hyacinth Church (Brown St) 11:30 AM-12:30 PM; River Bank Park (Main St) 1-2 PM. Turkey boxes with all the fixings including pies, first come first served until supplies last. Boxes cannot be reserved; mobile pantry also open for shopping.

title: Adult/Teen Craft: Resin Ornaments - Ages 13 and up
description: Make a few beautiful ornaments out of resin! Resin will need to cure for about a week before you can pick up your ornaments at the library. Please arrive by 12pm at the latest in order to have enough time to make an ornament or two. Ages 13 and up only due to resin chemicals.

title: Turkey Trot 5K & Kids 1 Mile
description: This is a great fundraiser for our Project Graduation for the class of 2027. All proceeds will go directly to the class. Our Kids Mile - designed for participants age 12 and under, starting at 8:30am at the high school track. A traditional 5K will start at 9:30am in the parking lot by the baseball field. Runners and walkers are all welcome. All participants will receive a commemorative Turkey Trot 2026 medal! You'll need to pick up your bib and race prep items. We'll be hosting bib pickup Admission: $25 adults/ $10 kids 1 mile

description: Craft with us! Make a miniature book out of our blank books and art supplies!

title: Thanksgiving Day (Closure)
description: Westbrook City Hall, the Walker Memorial Library, and the Westbrook Community Center's Administrative Offices will be closed on November 26 - 27 , 2026. Please note that the Westbrook Community Center facility will be open for public use and all classes and activities will continue, unless otherwise noted.

title: Kids' Christmas Party
venue: Westbrook Historical Society, Community Center, door #16
description: Hosted by the Westbrook Historical Society. Meet Santa and Mrs. Claus. Refreshments and small gifts for the kids. All are welcome.

title: Dana Warp Mill Holiday Art Walk & Market
description:
The 5th annual Art Walk has become an exciting event in Westbrook, especially as the whole city is decorated in its Christmas lights. This is your moment to explore the historic Dana Warp Mill and cross everyone off your Christmas list while supporting local small businesses and artists!

Free all day parking is available at the City's parking garage located at 7 Vertical Way, plus limited street parking around the mill. And don't forget to grab lunch or dinner at one of our great restaurants in Westbrook. 

The event is organized by Cee and she studios and supported by Discover Downtown Westbrook and Chinburg Properties.

title: Santa Claus is Coming To Rock Row
description: Free, family-friendly meet and greet with Santa, with photos at Cowbell and treats for all visitors. Rock Row may refuse parking or entry once capacity is reached. Contact: rockrowevents@waterstonepg.com.

title: Santa & Mrs. Claus at the Westbrook Community Center
description: Free visit and photo op with Santa & Mrs. Claus. Sittings at 5pm and 6pm. Register in advance; limited spots. Free admission with donation of a non-perishable food item for the Westbrook Families Feeding Families food pantry.

title: Spaghetti Dinner Fundraiser
description: Westbrook High School Class of '27 Project Graduation fundraiser. All-you-can-eat spaghetti, garlic bread, side salad, and hot or cold beverages. $8 per person, $4 for children under 10. Paid at the event, cash only.

title: Portland Ballet presents "A Victorian Nutcracker"
